test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete a piece of work in 10 days. B is 25% more efficient than A. How many days will B alone take to complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete a piece of work in 10 days

B is 25% more efficient than A.

**Concept used:**

Total work = efficiency of the worker × time taken by him

**Calculation:**

Let A's efficiency is 4a

So, B's efficiency = 4a + 4a × 25%

⇒ 5a

Now,

total work = 4a × 10

⇒ 40a

So, B will take to complete the task = 40a/5a

⇒ 8 days

**∴ B alone will take 8 days to complete the same work.**
